title: Verify listComments tool coverage against live Asana and Linear MCPs
description:
Phase B's gate could not be closed empirically: no Asana or Linear MCP was connected in the session that wrote the adapters, so the listComments tool names in trackers/asana.md and trackers/linear.md are documented hints rather than confirmed tools.

Confirm against a live connection:
- Asana: does the connected build expose a story-listing tool scoped to a task GID, and can comment-type stories be distinguished from system stories for field changes and section moves?
- Linear: is there a separate list-comments tool, or do comments arrive inside the get-issue response?

If either tracker has no path to reading comments, the closed-unmerged sentinel has no home there and that tracker falls back to the legacy file marker, which carries the known protected-branch limitation. That fallback is already specified, so this is a confirmation task rather than a blocker.

title: End-to-end read-through
description:
No automated test covers skill prose, so verify by reading. This stands in for a type checker and is not optional.

- Every operation named in a skill body exists in a contract file.
- No gh invocation survives outside forges/github.md.
- Every trackers.md line number referenced from another file still resolves.
- The GitHub path reads identically in behavior to main. This change is behavior-preserving on GitHub; any difference is a defect.

title: Rewrite execute step 11 on the forge contract
description:
Modify skills/execute/SKILL.md:96.

- Replace 'push the branch, and open the pull request with the gh command-line tool' with openReview(branch, base, title, body), honoring pushesForYou: when true the skill must NOT push separately. This matters because some forges' review CLIs push the ref themselves and a manual push produces a wrong branch state.
- Call publishReview(id), then updateState(inReview).
- Record '- Review: <id> <url>' alongside the existing '- PR:' line.
- Add the tier-3 branch: no review opened, print the manual handoff, apply inReview, state the ratchet disclosure.
- Leave the reconciliation, staging, and closing-commit rules untouched — they are already forge-neutral, and conventions.md:73-78 is load-bearing.
close_reason: execute step 11 rewritten on openReview/publishReview with pushesForYou honored, idempotent review reuse, review-id recording, and an explicit manual-tier branch; step 12 reports tier when no review exists

title: Add the forge question to first-run setup and gate merge-closer
description:
Modify skills/workbench-shared/trackers.md:138-198.

- Add the forge question to the numbered sequence, seeded by remote-host match then PATH probe. Record as 'forge:'.
- Gate the merge-closer question at :163-166 on ciHooks. When false, skip it and record 'merge-closer: none (forge has no hooks)'.
- Add 'forge:' to the profile format block at :184-194.
- Extend the repair pattern at :166 so a profile with no forge field gets the question on next load.
- Update the 'must run these five steps' wording at :145.
close_reason: Forge question added as step 3 (before merge-closer, since gating depends on ciHooks); merge-closer gated on ciHooks with 'none (forge has no hooks)' recorded otherwise; five->six step wording updated in both places; forge and merge-closer added to the profile format block

title: Move the closed-unmerged marker to a tracker comment
description:
Modify skills/workbench-shared/trackers.md:100-115.

Today this marker is pushed to the base branch. Most shared repos protect main, the push fails, and the skip condition at :98 never fires — so an abandoned review is re-reported on every single invocation, and approval.md:47 makes it a stop in BOTH approval modes. The user's answer is not persisted either, so answering does not help.

- Keep the reporting and the question at :106-109 unchanged.
- Replace the recorded .workbench/ line at :111-113 with a comment() carrying the sentinel 'workbench: review-closed-unmerged <url> <date>'.
- Idempotency is listComments plus a substring match on the sentinel, explicitly not 'the last comment says'.
- Keep :114-115: a different review later closed unmerged is new information; a recorded abandonment never blocks a later merge from closing the issue normally.
- Keep reading legacy '- PR closed unmerged:' lines as valid markers.
close_reason: Closed-unmerged marker moved to a tracker comment with the workbench: review-closed-unmerged sentinel, matched as a substring across the whole comment stream; file-based fallback retained for trackers without listComments, with its protected-branch limitation stated; legacy PR-closed-unmerged lines still read

title: Rebuild the sweep on review ids
description:
Modify skills/workbench-shared/trackers.md:80-98.

- Replace the gh pr view / gh pr list mechanics at :85 with getReviewState(id) per recorded id.
- Prefer the '- Review:' id; fall back to branch matching when only a legacy '- PR:' line exists, so existing repos keep working with no migration step.
- Skip the sweep entirely when reviewLookup is none, saying so once.
- Delete the stamp-push block at :91-98 in full.
- Keep the merged path's state re-read at :87-88 and make it the sole idempotency mechanism.
- Delete the --limit pagination warning; direct id lookup removes the hazard.
close_reason: Sweep rebuilt on getReviewState(id) per recorded review; listing and the --limit pagination hazard removed; branch fallback retained for legacy records and specified to drain; stamp-push block deleted with tracker state as the sole merged-path idempotency mechanism

title: Replace the gh preflight with verifyForge()
description:
Modify skills/workbench-shared/trackers.md:69-78.

Resolve the forge adapter, then call verifyForge(). Keep the one-pass property from :71 so a user missing both dependencies gets one stop naming everything to fix. Forge non-verification no longer stops the run: it selects a tier. Rewrite :78 ('Only a verified MCP and a verified gh allow the run to begin') so a verified MCP alone allows a tier-2 or tier-3 run to begin.
close_reason: Preflight now resolves the forge adapter and calls verifyForge; an unverified forge selects a tier instead of stopping the run. Credential/API prohibitions restated as tier-independent.

title: Implement listComments in both tracker adapters
description:
Modify skills/workbench-shared/trackers/asana.md and trackers/linear.md.

Name each tracker's typical comment-listing tool, following the existing convention that listed tool names are a starting hint rather than a guarantee (trackers.md:128-129).

Gate: confirm both MCPs actually expose comment listing. If either does not, stop and revisit the design before Phase C depends on it.
close_reason: listComments documented in both adapters with per-tracker specifics (Asana stories incl. system-story filtering; Linear separate tool or inline in getIssue). Gate NOT closed empirically - no tracker MCP connected this session; tracked as wb-y3n.7.4

title: Add listComments to the tracker contract
description:
Modify skills/workbench-shared/trackers.md contract table (~L12-24).

Add listComments(ref): return existing comment bodies on an issue, newest first. Update the 'exactly these eight operations' wording at trackers.md:9 to nine.

A separate operation is preferred over extending getIssue, which sits on the hot path of every run and should not carry a comment payload it usually does not need.
close_reason: listComments added as the ninth tracker contract operation; eight->nine wording updated; unavailability defined as a documented fallback rather than an error

title: Write the GitHub adapter (forges/github.md)
description:
Create skills/workbench-shared/forges/github.md. Relocate existing behavior unchanged.

- verifyForge: gh auth status, with the install/authenticate fix text from trackers.md:73-75.
- openReview: push, then gh pr create against base; return PR number as review id plus URL.
- publishReview: explicit no-op, noted as deliberate, with the draft fix called out as a deferred follow-up.
- getReviewState: gh pr view <id> --json state,mergedAt mapped to open/merged/closed-unmerged.
- Capabilities: ciHooks true, draftState true, pushesForYou false, reviewLookup by-id, stackedReviews retarget.
- Carry over trackers.md:73: never call the GitHub HTTP API, never read tokens from disk or environment.

Verify: every gh invocation that exists anywhere under skills/ today appears in this file.
close_reason: forges/github.md written: all gh invocations relocated (auth status, pr create, pr view --json state,mergedAt), capabilities declared, publishReview no-op documented as deliberate, HTTP-API prohibition carried over

title: Write the forge contract (forges.md)
description:
Create skills/workbench-shared/forges.md mirroring trackers.md structure and voice.

- Opening rule matching trackers.md:3-5: call the forge only through the contract, resolve the adapter at runtime, never call forge tools directly from a core skill body.
- Five-operation table.
- Declared capability table; absent means false; stackedReviews declared but drives no behavior yet.
- Adapter resolution order, with the rule that explicit configuration resolves while detection only seeds a question.
- The three tiers, and forge: none as tier 3 pinned rather than a fourth tier.
- The adapter-or-nothing rule, cross-referencing the Absolute boundary at execute/SKILL.md:9-18. This must live in forges.md itself, not only in the plan.
- Tier-3 ratchet disclosure: inReview is still applied and the run says plainly nothing will auto-close it.
- Base-branch resolution moved verbatim from trackers.md:37-49.

Verify: all five operations and all five capabilities are named; base-branch text matches what trackers.md held.
close_reason: forges.md written: 5 operations, 5 declared capabilities, resolution order, 3 tiers, adapter-or-nothing rule, ratchet disclosure, base-branch section moved from trackers.md:37-49

title: Verify and release
description: Phase G. Prose contracts have no compiler: a dangling operation name or stale cross-reference fails silently at runtime inside an agent. Reconcile the SkillSpector baseline, bump the plugin version, and read through end to end.

title: Rewire skill bodies and shared contracts
description: Phase E. execute step 11 calls openReview/publishReview instead of pushing and shelling out to gh. scaffold's forge gate is deleted since scaffold never touches a forge. approval.md, memory/checklist.md, agents.md, and conventions.md are updated for the contract and for review vocabulary.
close_reason: Phase E complete: execute rewired onto openReview/publishReview, scaffold gate deleted, approval/checklist/agents/conventions/memory updated

title: Rewire trackers.md onto the forge contract
description: Phase C. Preflight calls verifyForge() and no longer hard-stops. The done-on-merge sweep is rebuilt on review ids rather than branch names. The stamp-push block is deleted outright and the closed-unmerged marker moves to a tracker comment. Base-branch resolution moves to forges.md. First-run setup gains the forge question and gates merge-closer on ciHooks.
close_reason: Phase C complete: preflight, sweep, closed-unmerged marker, base-branch move, and first-run setup all rewired onto the forge contract

title: Tracker comment support for sweep idempotency
description:
Phase B. Removing the stamp push requires reading a sentinel comment off the issue, and getIssue does not return comments. Adds listComments(ref) as the ninth tracker contract operation and implements it in both tracker adapters.

Risk gate: if either MCP lacks a comment-listing tool, the closed-unmerged marker has no home on that tracker and the design needs a per-tracker fallback. Verify tool coverage here before Phase C depends on it.
close_reason: Phase B complete: ninth contract operation plus both adapter mappings. Live-MCP confirmation deferred to wb-y3n.7.4.

title: Forge contract and bundled adapters
description:
Phase A. New skills/workbench-shared/forges.md defining five operations (verifyForge, resolveBase, openReview, publishReview, getReviewState) and a declared capability table (ciHooks, draftState, pushesForYou, reviewLookup, stackedReviews), plus the GitHub adapter, the generic-git tier-3 fallback, and an adapter-authoring template.

Capabilities are declared in adapter files rather than returned by a capabilities() call, since they are static facts about a forge.
close_reason: Phase A complete: forges.md contract plus github, generic-git, and TEMPLATE adapters

title: Forge portability: abstract the code forge behind a contract
description:
Workbench abstracts the tracker but hardcodes GitHub. A non-GitHub forge cannot be added by writing an adapter; it requires editing the shared contracts, and a machine without gh hard-stops preflight before any work begins.

Extract a five-operation forge contract with adapters, mirroring the existing tracker abstraction, plus three capability tiers so an unknown internal forge degrades gracefully instead of stopping.

Design: docs/plans/2026-08-02-forge-portability-design.md
Plan: docs/plans/2026-08-02-forge-portability-plan.md
Branch: feat/multi-forge-support

Non-goals: multi-repo reviews, shipping public non-GitHub adapters, changing GitHub draft-PR behavior, removing the legacy PR checklist field, CI check awareness.

title: Bump the plugin version and sync
description:
Modify .claude-plugin/plugin.json, then run bin/sync-versions.sh.

Minor bump to 1.1.0: additive contract, behavior-preserving on GitHub. Add a 'forge' keyword. plugin.json is the source of truth and the script propagates to marketplace.json and README.md.

title: Reconcile the SkillSpector baseline
description:
Modify .skillspector-baseline.yaml (L63-69, L75). Two suppression reasons reference the GitHub Action template and an ASANA_TOKEN GitHub secret; update them to match the gated behavior.

Run bin/scan-skills.sh and resolve any new non-suppressed finding. New prose about probing PATH for CLIs is plausible new-finding territory.

title: Rewrite the forge sections of docs/workbench.md
description:
Modify docs/workbench.md:41, 121-130, 152, 161, 197-198, 299-336, 392, 407, 438.

- Requirements (:41) and setup (:121-130): gh is GitHub-specific, not universal.
- Add a section on the three tiers and what each does.
- Add a section on writing .workbench/forge.md, pointing at TEMPLATE.md.
- Rewrite 'How the tracker learns a PR merged' (:319-336) around ciHooks rather than three GitHub arrangements.
- Document the new tracker comment as new outbound writes to the user's tracker.
- Update the lifecycle diagram (:299-305) to review vocabulary.
- Note in troubleshooting (:392) that the protected-branch stamp failure is fixed.
close_reason: workbench.md: new Forges section with the tier table and the repo-local adapter path; merge-closer section rewritten around ciHooks; requirements, setup step 2, first-run table, lifecycle diagram, repo-contents table, troubleshooting, limitations, and upgrading all updated

title: Add the review-id field to the checklist format
description:
Modify skills/workbench-shared/memory/checklist.md:7,16,31,40,45.

Add '- Review: (filled at open)'. Keep '- PR:' as a legacy field that is read but no longer the primary key. Update the init and parentTask descriptions accordingly. Additive only — removing the legacy field is a fast-follow.
close_reason: Review line (id + url) added to the checklist format and to init; PR retained as a read-only legacy line with branch fallback documented

title: Update approval.md for tiers and the once-only stop
description:
Modify skills/workbench-shared/approval.md:36-47.

- The closed-unmerged stop at :47 stays a never-skipped stop; note it now fires once per abandoned review rather than on every run.
- Preflight's never-skipped stop at :36-41 narrows to the tracker MCP.
- Classify the tier-2 offer as a stop that fires in both modes: auto mode must not pick a forge CLI unattended.
close_reason: Preflight stop narrowed to the tracker MCP; closed-unmerged stop notes it now fires once; tier-2 forge-CLI acceptance added as a never-skipped stop

title: Delete scaffold's forge gate
description:
Modify skills/scaffold/SKILL.md:42. Remove the GitHub CLI clause.

Scaffold only creates tracker issues and never touches a forge, so gating it on gh verification is a bug rather than a portability problem. Delete it rather than porting it to verifyForge(). The tracker-MCP stop stays exactly as it is.
close_reason: scaffold no longer gates on the forge; it creates tracker issues and never opens a review, so the gate was a bug rather than a portability issue

title: Update execute preflight and final reporting
description:
Modify skills/execute/SKILL.md:50-58 and :97.

- :53 — stop only when the tracker MCP does not verify; forge non-verification selects a tier instead.
- :57-58 — cleanup-phrase handling stays, but a claim about a review's fate cannot be confirmed when reviewLookup is none; say so rather than confirming.
- :97 — the final summary reports the review URL when there is one, and the tier when there is not.
close_reason: Step 1 no longer stops on forge non-verification and states the resolved tier; step 2 cleanup-phrase confirmation goes through getReviewState and refuses to act on unverifiable claims when reviewLookup is none

title: Gate Linear's merge-closer and condition its integration logic
description:
Modify skills/workbench-shared/trackers/linear.md:26-73.

Same gating as Asana. Additionally the 'Closes <ref>' behavior and the 'skip updateState(done) because the integration handles it' logic at :26-40 are GitHub-integration specific — condition them on the resolved forge being GitHub. On any other forge, Linear closes through updateState as normal.
close_reason: Linear's GitHub-integration arrangement scoped to the GitHub forge; merge-closer gated; closed-unmerged handling repointed at the sentinel comment; stale stamp reference removed

title: Gate Asana's merge-closer offer on ciHooks
description: Modify skills/workbench-shared/trackers/asana.md:55-78. Condition the GitHub Action offer and the native-integration recommendation on ciHooks. Keep the workflow template at :87-159 but scope it explicitly to GitHub-capable forges.
close_reason: Asana merge-closer gated on ciHooks; native-integration and Action sections both scoped to GitHub; inReview comment now conditions its done-on-merge promise on reviewLookup

title: Move base-branch resolution out of trackers.md
description:
Modify skills/workbench-shared/trackers.md:37-49. Delete the section, leaving a pointer to forges.md.

Base-branch resolution is a VCS/forge concern with nothing tracker-specific in it. Update every in-repo reference to 'the base-branch rules in trackers.md' — execute/SKILL.md:67 is one.
close_reason: Base-branch resolution moved to forges.md with a pointer left behind; execute:67 repointed and forges.md added to execute's Read first list so the reference is not dangling

title: Write the adapter-authoring template
description:
Create skills/workbench-shared/forges/TEMPLATE.md, an annotated skeleton a team copies to .workbench/forge.md.

This is the deliverable that actually serves an unknown internal forge: we cannot ship adapters for forges whose names, hosts, and CLIs we do not know. Each operation carries a comment on what it must return and what breaks when it is wrong. Call out that reviewLookup: none is a legitimate answer and that a partial adapter beats none.
close_reason: forges/TEMPLATE.md written: annotated skeleton for .workbench/forge.md, per-operation guidance on what breaks when wrong, partial adapters endorsed

title: Write the generic-git fallback adapter
description:
Create skills/workbench-shared/forges/generic-git.md, the tier-3 fallback.

- verifyForge: verifies git and a reachable origin only; passes when those hold.
- openReview: push, then print branch, base, suggested title and body for a human to open the review by hand. Returns no review id.
- publishReview: no-op. getReviewState: always unknown.
- Capabilities: ciHooks false, draftState false, pushesForYou false, reviewLookup none.
- State the consequence plainly: the sweep does not run, and the ratchet disclosure is required.
close_reason: forges/generic-git.md written: tier-3 fallback, reviewLookup none, manual handoff on openReview, ratchet consequence stated

title: Document forge portability
description: Phase F. docs/workbench.md gains the three tiers and the repo-local adapter path, and its 'How the tracker learns a PR merged' section is rewritten around ciHooks rather than three GitHub arrangements. README moves gh from an unconditional prerequisite to a GitHub-specific one.
close_reason: Phase F complete: workbench guide and README updated for forge portability

title: Gate tracker adapters on forge capabilities
description: Phase D. The Asana and Linear merge-closer offers write .github/workflows/workbench-close.yml unconditionally. On a forge with no GitHub Actions equivalent that writes a file which never executes and records merge-closer: installed, asserting a capability that does not exist. Gate both on ciHooks, and condition Linear's GitHub-integration logic on the resolved forge.
close_reason: Phase D complete: both tracker adapters gated on ciHooks, GitHub-specific arrangements scoped to the GitHub forge

title: Drive inReview off publishReview on GitHub
description:
A draft PR currently moves the issue to inReview even though it is explicitly not ready, so the tracker says 'in review' while the work is not reviewable. This is a live GitHub defect, not only a portability one.

Deferred from the forge-portability change so that change stays provably behavior-preserving on GitHub: mixing 'make it portable' with 'change what it does on the forge everyone uses' makes the diff unreviewable.

Depends on publishReview and draftState existing in the contract.

title: Update the README prerequisites
description: Modify README.md:31 and :38. Move the GitHub CLI from an unconditional prerequisite to a GitHub-specific one, and mention multi-forge support in the skill description.
close_reason: README description and prerequisites updated: gh is GitHub-specific, forge adapter named as the general requirement, degraded path mentioned

title: Neutralize forge vocabulary in shared contracts
description:
Modify skills/workbench-shared/conventions.md:78 and :80-90, plus residual 'pull request' uses in trackers.md and memory.md:65.

'Pull request' is used exclusively across the repo today and 'merge request' appears nowhere. Shared contracts move to 'review'; the GitHub adapter keeps 'pull request' where it names real gh behavior. memory.md:65 currently justifies the no-dual-truth invariant partly by the merge-closer Action's grep — restate it forge-neutrally.
close_reason: conventions.md moved to review vocabulary and states the universal uncommitted-work hazard the reconciliation guards; memory.md no-dual-truth invariant restated forge-neutrally and now names the review id

title: Update the agent command allowlist
description: Modify skills/workbench-shared/agents.md:43. Replace the literal gh with the resolved forge adapter's CLI, keeping gh as the GitHub example.
close_reason: Allowlist names the resolved forge adapter's CLI with gh as the GitHub example, and calls out repo-local adapters

title: Make execute's trigger phrases forge-neutral
description: Modify skills/execute/SKILL.md:3. Keep the GitHub-flavored phrases since users do say 'PR', and add review-neutral equivalents so the skill routes on other forges' vocabulary too.
close_reason: Trigger phrases keep GitHub-flavored wording and add review-neutral equivalents; summary line names forge adapters

title: Fast-follow: deferred behavior changes
description: Deliberately excluded from the forge-portability branch so that change stays behavior-preserving on GitHub and therefore reviewable. Both are real defects, tracked here rather than dropped.

title: Remove the legacy PR field and branch fallback
description:
Once repositories have cycled through at least one run on the new format, remove the '- PR:' field from memory/checklist.md and delete the sweep's branch-matching fallback, leaving review ids as the sole key.

Do not run this until enough time has passed that in-flight .workbench/ files carry '- Review:' lines.
